key_heuristics: Force every numeric claim through witness_claim with explicit count + citation (source, ts, actor).
Separate witnessed timeline (what was observed) from causal reconstruction (inferred graph).
Use anomaly detection on observations vs prior to surface blast radius and novel entities.
Cross-check contradictions in claims before root cause; contradictions often point to missing context or deception.
Always produce actionable items with owner + deadline + verification criterion.
causal_patterns: Trigger -> enabling condition (config drift, missing guard) -> propagation path (via shared infra) -> impact
Human factor: alert fatigue or change window violation often the silent contributor
contradiction_heuristics: Same metric reported with >20% variance across sources within 5min window -> flag for investigation
extraction_note: Seeded from high-quality security-incident-postmortem framework + reasoning primitives (witness, causality, contradictions, anomaly).
